features.title: Jujutsu workspace lifecycle and ownership
features.summary: Registers jj workspaces with a coordinator identity separate from Session, Agent, path, workspace topic, and jj revision; tracks owning Sessions over time and never infers readiness from an idle Session.
failureModes: A workspace path that is not inside a jj repository is rejected without touching the filesystem.
A deleted or relocated workspace is marked missing instead of assumed complete.
An idle Session does not make its workspace ready for integration.
Multiple Sessions may own one workspace; detachment is recorded, never inferred.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv jj CLI through the DSH subprocess service; no shell and no agent-supplied arguments.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary jj repositories in src/jj.integration.test.ts; no jj mock is used.

verification.reason: The workspace browser journey is exercised by the real-jj host tests in this revision; a dedicated Playwright scenario is deferred until the panel is composed in a profile.

verification.testName: registers a workspace and records its owning session
handles a missing source workspace without advancing the spine

features.title: Serialized canonical integration queue
features.summary: Durable integration candidates capture immutable change and commit ids, refresh the canonical bookmark, duplicate the source revision onto it, block on conflict, validate, and advance the bookmark only on success; source workspaces are never modified.

configuration.constraints: Existing jj bookmark that represents the accepted canonical state; never inferred from recent activity.
Optional operator-configured command run in an ephemeral staging workspace at the duplicated revision; a non-zero exit leaves the bookmark unchanged.
When false, only the candidate owner Session or a configured coordinator Session may run integration; the browser API acts as the human operator.

failureModes: A conflicting duplicate is recorded as blocked and the canonical bookmark is not advanced.
A failed validation leaves the canonical bookmark unchanged.
A source revision that evolves after queueing is marked stale instead of integrated.
Two concurrent integration requests are serialized; the canonical bookmark is never advanced twice from one candidate.
A second coordinator process holding the lock is refused with integration-busy.

externalDependencies.boundary: jj duplicate --onto performs reconciliation without rewriting the source revision; jj resolve --list reports conflicts.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Real temporary jj repositories; integration behavior is verified against jj 0.45 rather than mocked.

verification.reason: The queue browser journey is exercised by the real-jj host tests in this revision; a dedicated Playwright scenario is deferred until the panel is composed in a profile.

verification.testName: integrates work started from an older canonical revision
blocks a conflicting candidate without advancing the spine or touching the source workspace
marks a candidate stale when the source revision evolves after queueing
detects an already integrated candidate and does not duplicate it
leaves the canonical spine unchanged when validation fails
serializes concurrent integration requests without corrupting the spine
orders explicit dependencies before their dependents
